channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Scientists find new method to produce hydrogen from water
item.description: A new light-activated material can efficiently produce hydrogen from water without an additional expensive metal catalyst, researchers say.

item.title: Forgotten 30-year forest experiment yields surprising results
item.description: A 30-year forestry experiment in Australia found heavily thinned mountain ash forests grew unusually large trees while recovering enough carbon.

item.title: Tiny magnetic fields may explain universe expansion discrepancy
item.description: Magnetic fields formed after the Big Bang could account for the ongoing disagreement about the universe's expansion rate.

item.title: Oklahoma meteor impact occurred 100 million years later than believed
item.description: A buried crater in Oklahoma is nearly 100 million years younger than previously thought, according to zircon crystal analysis.
